apps.name: Nuvio
apps.subtitle: A free, open-source media app for your phone, your desktop, and the TV you already own.
apps.localizedDescription:
A free, open-source media app for your phone, your desktop, and the TV you already own.

Bring your own sources. Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles, and your place saved on every screen.

apps.name: TwitchUnblock
apps.subtitle: Twitch VODs & Live sans abonnement
apps.localizedDescription: Regardez vos VODs et streams Twitch sans subscription, avec sélecteur de qualité, PiP natif, historique, sync cloud et support VLC / Outplayer / Infuse.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Going back in a live (−10 s or the bar) now plays at your chosen speed, up to 2×, to catch up, then back to 1× at the live edge; the speed is also in the player's ⋯ menu during a live
- The player no longer shows your VOD speed next to the timer during a live when it doesn't apply
- Rewinding into a live's recording now brings back your chosen playback speed once you're away from its edge, instead of staying at 1×
- Apple's player now drops to 1× near the edge of a live recording and shows it, instead of a 2× that didn't actually play
- The player now checks the speed it really plays at: it applies it again, then shows the real speed if playback still can't keep up
- Live notifications through the ntfy app are gone: for instant ones, install the TwitchUnblock website as a web app (Settings → Features in testing → Open the website shows how)
- If you had ntfy on, the app tells you once and stops the server from posting to your topic: you can uninstall ntfy
- Chat: tapping a GIF from Twitch's GIF keyboard opens its card (title, author, GIPHY page, link to copy) instead of the sender's messages
- A live paused by your AirPods, earphones or iOS and resumed from them or the lock screen now picks up at the live edge instead of where it stopped
- iPhone Duo: the full-size player in landscape now hides the status column on the side, so the video fills the display
- The player's rotate button goes away when iOS doesn't let the app turn the screen (apps in a window, as on the iPhone Duo's inner display)
- Live: three more sources to pick in Settings → Player (PerfProd Asia, Albania proxy 2, Luminous Europe 2); if you change nothing, each one is tried right after its neighbor.
- New Background playback setting: keep playing, audio only or pause when the screen locks or you switch apps
- Stream archives show the real time of day of each moment, and ⋯ → Go to a time of day jumps to it
- Clips: ⋯ → Watch in the VOD opens the original VOD at that moment, and ⋯ → Download the clip saves it
- The higher-quality and account notices now show only once
- Update now opens a help page for every installer when Feather, SideStore or AltStore isn't found
- A brief Twitch error at launch no longer signs you out of the web session
- Signing out of the web session without an app account now lets you sign in with another account
- Lists are no longer hidden behind the mini player and the multi-live bar
- Picture in Picture now follows raids and the next VOD of Play all instead of closing
- Apple TV: Menu now closes an open category instead of quitting the app
- Fixed: a live could be wrongly reported as "not available in your region".
- Vertical video: going back now returns to the ad-free source, and drops keep progressing while the vertical picture plays.
- With the chat on top of the video (vertical video, overlay chat in landscape), the pinned-message bar is now see-through instead of a black band.
- The player's bottom bar no longer squeezes the live's duration when there are many buttons (vertical video): the buttons move to a second row.
- Vertical streams now look like the Twitch app's vertical view: the picture fills the player and the chat sits on its bottom, see-through (double-tap or the Chat button hides it).
- Vertical streams: when a streamer also sends Twitch a vertical picture (Dual Format: mobile games, IRL), a ▯ button in the player switches to it, like in the Twitch app. The choice is remembered.
- A live that Twitch keeps to some countries now says so (“not available in your region”) instead of “No source answered”.
- The quality menus now show Source with its resolution, like “1440p (Source)” or “1080p60 (Source)”, when the stream provides it.
- Pinch to zoom in the app's player now zooms right where you pinch, and moving both fingers while pinching moves the picture, like the Twitch app.
- The Live Activity and Now Playing now step aside when another app takes the sound or the video stays paused in the background, so tapping the Dynamic Island opens the app that's actually playing (e.g. Spotify).
- Channel points: when an ad blocker or filtering DNS blocks Twitch's watch-time address, the watched minute goes through the TwitchUnblock server so passive points and chests still count.
- Wide windows (iPhone Duo's inner display in landscape, iPad): the tab bar becomes a column of tabs on the left, leaving the whole height to the content; it follows your tab order and hidden tabs.
- Emote picker: a new "Mine" tab, first, lists every Twitch emote your account can use in any chat — your subscriptions' emotes, Prime/Turbo and Twitch's global emotes — grouped by channel, and search covers it.
- Large screens: grids of lives, VODs, clips and categories show more, smaller tiles (3 columns in portrait and 4 in landscape on the iPhone Duo's inner display, up to 5 on iPad) instead of two giant ones.
- iPhone Duo: the header, grids, tab bar and tour bubbles no longer slide under iOS's status column on the outer display and on the inner display in landscape.
- New setting "PiP when leaving the player" (Settings → Player, off by default): swiping a live stream or VOD down, or tapping back, opens it in Picture in Picture instead of the mini player
- Picture in Picture: starting it now shrinks the player so you can keep using the app, instead of leaving a black full-screen player to close
- Picture in Picture: the window's expand button now brings the player back full size, on the same video
- A channel's bot commands (Nightbot, StreamElements, Fossabot, Moobot) are now on its channel page too, so they can be checked while the channel is offline.
- New settings in Settings → General → Customize the app → Chat · banners (all on by default): hide the chat's notification bell, the chat mode badge ("Followers for 10h"…) and the channel points crown; the bell stays on the channel page and channel points open from the chat's ⋯ menu.
- Channel points can be opened from the chat's ⋯ menu whenever the crown isn't shown, landscape included.
- New setting Settings → General → Customize the app → Chat · banners → Special Events (on by default): hide Twitch's own reward campaigns such as "1 Month of Apple TV" while keeping the channel's drops card.
- Settings: the app no longer crashes when opening Settings on iOS 18
- Logs are now fully in the app's language: categories, settings changes and details built while the app runs no longer stay in French
- Settings → General: the language list moved to its own page (App language), like iOS's settings
- Swipe from the left edge to go back in Settings, from a category's live channels and from a channel opened from search results
- When the tool that installed the app doesn't allow changing its icon (LiveContainer, GBox…), Settings now says so instead of offering icons that fail
- Followed categories can use compact covers (3 per row, 4 on iPad) and be sorted A → Z, in Settings → General → Customize the app
- In landscape, the full-size player (app's or Apple's) and multi-live now let the home indicator fade after a few seconds, like video apps, instead of keeping it over the picture.
- Multi-live: tap a tile's speaker to hear several videos at once, and long-press it for that tile's volume; tapping a tile still makes it the only one you hear.
- Hide an emote: long-press it in the chat, or "Hide this emote" on its card; it then shows as the typed word, from any source, in the live, VOD and multi-live chat.
- Settings → Chat → Hidden emotes lists them to show them again; the list follows your account and is shared with the website.
- New setting Settings → Chat → Show the message box (on by default): hide it if you only read the chat, the room goes to the messages; channel points and the chat's ⋯ menu stay as small buttons at the bottom right.
- Closing a channel page opened from the full-size player (name, title or chat) now brings the player back full size instead of shrinking it to the mini player.
- Traditional Chinese interface language (thanks to trend0522)
- The backup now carries everything to move between the app and TU Test: pinned channels, all settings (appearance, notifications, player, downloads…), the customization and Continue watching, never your Twitch sign-ins
- Importing a backup asks Everything or Channels only, then lists what was restored
- Long-press a video in Continue watching to resume it or remove it from the list
- Settings → About shows the build number next to the version (tap to copy)
- When an install tool put an old build under the latest version's number, the update alert explains how to reinstall and links to the right IPA
- The app now follows iOS's text size (up to Accessibility 2), live: Home, Discover, search, channel pages, settings and chat messages get bigger
- Other improvements and fixes
